title: File properties report does not get updated unlike Dolphin ~/Desktop folder after the file is overwritten by cp
line: The Properties dialog opened from the desktop now shows the current size and modification time of a file that was overwritten in place.
explanation: Folder View lists desktop:/, which KIO does not watch itself; it relies on the desktopnotifier kded module to send change notifications. That module watched ~/Desktop with a QFileSystemWatcher, which only reports entries being added, removed or renamed, so a file overwritten in place (cp, dd) sent nothing and the desktop kept the KFileItem from when the file first appeared, which is what the Properties dialog shows. The module now also watches the files in the desktop folder with KDirWatch and sends FilesChanged for a modified file, so the item's size and dates are refreshed.

commits.message:
kioworkers/desktop: refresh desktop items when a file is rewritten in place

The desktop notifier only watched the Desktop folder for entries being
added or removed, so a file overwritten in place kept its old thumbnail,
size and date until F5. Also watch the files and send FilesChanged.

BUG: 501016
BUG: 523799

media.caption: Master: test.dat created with dd (26 MiB), then overwritten with a 2 MiB file via cp; Properties from the desktop still says 0 B and Modified 4:43:11 (the file is 2 MiB, modified 4:43:45)
With the fix: same steps, Properties shows 2.0 MiB and Modified 4:45:23, matching the file on disk

review.text: This addresses the real cause: desktopnotifier's QFileSystemWatcher doesn't report in-place rewrites, so desktop:/ items kept stale KFileItems. Adding a KDirWatch with WatchFiles and emitting FilesChanged for the desktop: URL is a small and fitting change. Before/after Properties dialogs show the stale and updated size. This is the same commit as the 501016 fix: submit only one of them. It also touches desktopnotifier.cpp like the 524339 fix, so rebase whichever lands second.
